scope: All fifteen source chapters. Controls mean no injected defects, not proven flawless prose.

items.quote: while still wearing the suit in which Anton had died
items.reason: The relative clause can imply Nia is wearing the suit Anton died inside, although the intended account appears to concern Nia’s own suit worn at the time of his death. This is a wording ambiguity already in the source, not an injected event or a confirmed extra suit transfer.
items.handling: Do not automatically reject a reasonable editorial observation about this wording as a false positive. Final judgment is still required. The r2 first-person rewrite explicitly describes Nia’s own suit; controls and frozen DS09 remain unchanged.
items.note: 同意单列为 minor / local 的底本文字歧义：定语从句可误读为 Nia 穿着 Anton 死亡时所穿的那件衣服，不能据此断言发生衣服转移事件。r2 已明确 Nia 自己的衣服；冻结 DS09 和控制组保持不变。合理指出这一歧义的编辑意见不宜机械判成误报。此项不计入14项补充复核、36项注入或4项结构性缺陷。
